body.x: Cammsys introduced its camera cam "Panoram 360" at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

Cammsys started off as a semiconductor device manufacturer, and began manufacturing camera modules for mobile phones since 2001. Now, it is a leader in camera module sector with a monthly production of 20 million units in factories in China and Vietnam.

Panorama 360 is a camera for cars that makes the observation of the car in 360 degrees possible. It received 2016 KES Innovation Awards. It can do shape adjusting with just one touch, and the angle of the view for one of the lenses is 195 degrees. The brightness has become lighter and dead angle notification has been removed to satisfy the customers' needs.
It also has MOD(Moving Object Detection), LDWS(Lane Departure warning System), and FCWS(Forward Collision Warning System) included in the system.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
